estimands.additional_clustering: none because each source game appears once
estimands.o_i: one iff at least one A_pos(S) action induces a downgrade
estimands.state_weighting: each frozen state has equal weight
estimands.strict_terminal_successor: known zero response-downgrade indicator, retained in A_pos denominator

main_experiment_unlaunched.abstention: any missing Malom value, illegal bridge result, or failed engine search abstains the whole state and is never converted to zero
main_experiment_unlaunched.activation: only after conclusion A and separate product-owner authorization
main_experiment_unlaunched.measurement: exhaust complete A_pos(S) once per state

mechanism_success_gate.rationale: require at least one extra induced downgrade per 20 source states even after uncertainty before paying for prediction

main_experiment_unlaunched.node_budget: frozen highest preprobe budget passing all signal gates
main_experiment_unlaunched.state_pool_rule: 360 source-game-unique states, 120 per phase, selected from the same frozen 6,400-game research-exploration population by a new blind SHA-256 namespace, excluding preprobe states

preprobe.budget_rationale: 10^3, 10^4, and 10^5 cover three search scales; 500,000 is the formal-evaluation upper anchor
preprobe.measurement: exhaust every frozen A_pos action at every budget

signal_gate.rationale: below 1% is operationally near-zero in this 36-state probe; above 30% makes random safe choice too error-rich; a 5pp oracle increment is the minimum mechanism value worth a separate learnability experiment

preprobe.timing: per search plus per process/replay cell wall time

uncertainty.interpretation: fixed-pool engineering interval, not population inference
uncertainty.zero_event_rule: return empirical zero with no prior or pseudo-event

preprobe_decision.A: at least one budget passes every frozen signal gate
preprobe_decision.A_action: report recommended budget and request separate main authorization
preprobe_decision.B: no budget passes every frozen signal gate
preprobe_decision.C: determinism, identity, A_pos, or estimator definition fails
preprobe_decision.C_action: stop and redesign; do not average repeated stochastic searches

research_question: Within A_pos(S), can directed action choice increase the probability that one fixed-node deterministic Sanmill response loses its own best positional WDL tier?

sanmill_contract.command: go logical nodes N; no explicit depth
sanmill_contract.time_control_priority: MoveTimeMs=0; fixed nodes are binding except retained phase-depth early stop
